items.title: Provisioning and session controls
items.summary: Single sign-on, required two-factor, scoped tokens, and the audit log have shipped. What's left is the lifecycle around them: keeping an organization's roster in step with its identity provider automatically, and giving owners control over how long, and where, their members stay signed in.
includes: SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning from your identity provider
Org session policies: session lifetime and idle timeouts
Sign members out of an organization everywhere, at once
Built on the same roles, scopes, and audit trail as the rest of the platform

items.title: Agents and cross-system insight
items.summary: Beyond a single assistant: run, route, and orchestrate agents over your data with humans in the loop, and get real cross-system insight, like what actually changed across everything this week.
includes: Run, route, and orchestrate agents
Humans in the loop by default
Insight across every connected system
"What changed everywhere this week", answered

items.title: AI assistant and MCP
items.summary: Operate Flagon by asking. An assistant that acts with your identity and permissions: it reads instantly and proposes changes for you to confirm, and a public MCP server gives external agents the same abilities.
includes: Operate the platform in natural language
Runs as you, within your permissions
Reads run immediately; changes are proposed to confirm
A public MCP server for external agents and editors
Usage metered per organization

items.title: Bidirectional sync with external systems
items.summary: The heart of Flagon: your projects and teams stay in sync with the systems those definitions already live in, in both directions. Define once, and let it flow to and from the tools you already use.
includes: Two-way sync, not one-way import
Connect the systems your definitions already live in
Changes reconcile in both directions
Built on the same API and permissions model as everything else

items.title: CLI and SDKs
items.summary: The platform from your terminal and your code. A first-class CLI for projects, deploys, and logs, and client SDKs so Flagon fits into whatever you already build with.
includes: A CLI for auth, projects, deploys, and logs
Client SDKs generated from the API
Local MCP over stdio for editors and agents
One consistent contract across all of them

items.title: Public API
items.summary: Everything the product does is an API call first. A documented HTTP API with token authentication and scopes, so anything you can do in the dashboard you can automate.
includes: OpenAPI-documented endpoints, always current with the product
Token authentication with fine-grained scopes
Consistent pagination and error shapes
The same contract the dashboard itself is built on

items.title: Skills and governance
items.summary: Make the platform's power reusable and safe to run. Packaged skills that capture how your team works, and the governance to let agents and people operate confidently at scale.
includes: Reusable skills that encode how you work
Guardrails and approvals
Policy and governance across the org
Safe autonomy as the surface grows

items.title: Usage and billing
items.summary: Metering turned into plans and limits. AI usage is already metered per organization, with a daily cap enforced today; this turns that into a usage dashboard, transparent plan limits, and billing, priced to sit below what it costs to run.
includes: A usage dashboard for every organization
Plan limits and enforcement beyond today's free-plan caps
Transparent, honest pricing
Billing, payment methods, and invoicing
